unit: One final-human-confirmed statistical candidate, not one unique underlying defect or paper.
selection: Copied final human-reviewed workbook labels: retain, statistical_results, confirmed_issue; frozen report relationship S_C or S_W.
provenance: The earlier Notes were authored by Claude Opus 5.5 high AI reviewer runs. The user confirmed subsequent human review of the copied workbook decisions. Those copied decisions determine selection and substantive status and are unchanged. The new semantic taxonomy and assignments are LLM-assisted content categories, not newly human-validated judgments or independent verification of trial errors.

categories.label_zh: 计数、百分比与人群分母
categories.inclusion: Counts, percentages, denominators, totals, missingness accounting, or population-stage counts fail to reconcile.
categories.exclusion_and_boundary: Includes local percent/decimal typos and mislabeled analysis-stage counts. Excludes an identified row/group/outcome transfer (ATTRIBUTION), and score-scale definitions (ANALYSIS_DEFINITION). Analysis-population denominator/header swaps remain COUNT_DENOM; a direct outcome or treatment result transfer is ATTRIBUTION. Numerical fraction-to-percent conversion is included even when it describes composition rather than participant counts.
categories.label: Counts, percentages, and population accounting

categories.inclusion: The effect estimate, its construction, scale, or identity is inconsistent or insufficiently specified; includes ratios asserted in the Notes to be nonestimable.
categories.exclusion_and_boundary: Includes RR versus OR, transposed/pooled risks, SMD construction, effect-scale transformation and point-estimate typos. Excludes pure contrast sign (DIRECTION), isolated uncertainty bounds (INTERVAL_DISPERSION), and direct row swaps (ATTRIBUTION).
categories.label: Effect estimates and estimand identity

categories.label_zh: 区间与分布摘要的数值一致性
categories.inclusion: Confidence/credible intervals or distribution summaries have inconsistent bounds, order, location, precision, width, or cross-location values.
categories.exclusion_and_boundary: Includes interval-endpoint sign/decimal typos and impossible median/IQR relations. Excludes diagnosed confidence-level/method misdefinition (ANALYSIS_DEFINITION); a central CI/P significance conflict is TEST_INFERENCE unless a localized bound defect is explicitly resolved. For candidates combining several independent mechanisms, a shared uncertainty defect across estimates may be selected as primary; such unresolved priority choices remain explicitly ambiguous and the inferential mechanism is retained secondarily.
categories.label: Interval and distribution-summary coherence

categories.inclusion: Printed P values fail to reproduce or disagree with intervals; significance, decision-rule, or bound-to-decision-margin explanations conflict with the reported numerical evidence.
categories.exclusion_and_boundary: Includes false no-significance summaries, the number of cases meeting a statistical decision rule, and an incorrectly worded noninferiority-bound comparison even when the conclusion is correct. Excludes an explicitly diagnosed undisclosed method/level mismatch (ANALYSIS_DEFINITION) and a localized corrected interval endpoint (INTERVAL_DISPERSION).
categories.label: P values and inferential consistency

categories.inclusion: The point-estimate sign, contrast order, favorable axis, residual sign, trend direction, or benefit/harm interpretation conflicts with the numerical contrast or display.
categories.exclusion_and_boundary: Includes a locally dropped point sign regardless of severity. An isolated interval-endpoint sign is INTERVAL_DISPERSION; transfers between treatment columns or outcome rows are ATTRIBUTION. Incorrect wording of an interval bound relative to an inferential decision margin is TEST_INFERENCE, even if the ultimate conclusion remains correct.
categories.label: Contrast sign and benefit direction

categories.inclusion: The Notes identify values assigned to the wrong arm, outcome, row, or categorical bin, or copied from a different identified row/panel.
categories.exclusion_and_boundary: A specifically identified source-to-destination mapping takes precedence over generic count, CI, or P inconsistency. Excludes population-stage naming alone (COUNT_DENOM), estimate/scale names (EFFECT_ESTIMAND), or merely suspected transfers with no specific mapping.
categories.label: Result attribution, swaps, and duplication

categories.inclusion: Conflicting or missing definitions of models, tests, predictors, censoring, eligibility, confidence levels, priors, summary statistics, units, or questionnaire scoring.
categories.exclusion_and_boundary: Includes explicitly diagnosed method/level mismatch even when first noticed via CI/P discordance. Effect-estimator identity goes to EFFECT_ESTIMAND; arithmetic analysis-population accounting goes to COUNT_DENOM.
categories.label: Analysis and measure definitions

primary_selection_rules: Read the full Notes, including negation and qualifying explanations; titles supply context only. Do not import judgments.json or other rationales.
Choose the mechanism supported by the retained claim. Successful comparator rows and rejected broader allegations are not issues to be coded.
A specifically identified row, arm, outcome, or bin transfer takes ATTRIBUTION over a generic numeric discrepancy; mere suspected copying does not.
Point-contrast sign or benefit interpretation takes DIRECTION; isolated interval-endpoint signs remain INTERVAL_DISPERSION.
Population-stage counts and headers remain COUNT_DENOM; effect-estimator/scale identity is EFFECT_ESTIMAND; model/test/scoring/summary-statistic identity is ANALYSIS_DEFINITION.
An explicitly diagnosed confidence-level or CI/P method mismatch takes ANALYSIS_DEFINITION over a generic inferential contradiction.

For genuinely independent issues bundled in one candidate, choose the central retained issue from the full note, record secondary mechanisms and multiple_issues, and lower confidence where primary selection remains contestable.
Local transcription/formatting is a secondary tag; it does not replace a statistical mechanism category or determine severity.
If no supported primary mechanism is recoverable, use UNCLASSIFIABLE with the reason. Do not infer a category from a title alone.
A comparison of an interval bound against an inferential decision margin is TEST_INFERENCE, not DIRECTION; the latter concerns signed contrasts, trends, residuals, or benefit/harm interpretation.

A specific interval repeating another identified outcome's interval is ATTRIBUTION. The code records the mapping asserted in the Note and does not claim a copying operation was independently verified.
Effect-scale transformation, including log-times-100 effects mislabeled as percentage changes, is EFFECT_ESTIMAND.

Where independent mechanisms coexist and neither is uniquely primary, assign one counting category while retaining audit_status=ambiguous, alternatives, and secondary categories. This does not change confirmation or substantive status.
substantive_status: Copied without change from final human-reviewed labels; never inferred from category, wording, or confidence.

confidence.high: Mechanism is directly supported by the full Notes; certainty concerns classification, not truth of the alleged trial error.
confidence.medium: Primary choice has competing mechanisms or relies on an explicitly tentative diagnostic mapping.
confidence.low: Mechanism is weakly supported; retain explicit uncertainty rather than invent specificity.

secondary_tags: Optional descriptive tags may overlap. They are not mutually exclusive issue counts and must not be summed as candidates.
limitations: Candidate records may overlap in underlying cause, especially explicitly linked candidates.
Four sampled publication years are available, not a continuous annual series.
Counts profile confirmed candidate records and do not estimate prevalence among all trials.
A narrative explanation in an earlier AI note is evidence for coding its meaning, not newly verified evidence of a trial error.
method: LLM full-note semantic coding with complete second-agent audit and documented reconciliation
audit_design: The second agent read all 139 full Notes and saved independent proposed categories, exact excerpts, and rationales before opening the v1 coding file. The agents shared the taxonomy and discussed boundary cases; the subsequent audit explicitly inspected v1 and reconciled differences. This is not a blinded interrater reliability study; no kappa or human-coder reliability statistic is claimed.

reconciliation.ambiguous_means: Only the primary content-category priority is ambiguous; the pre-existing human-reviewed confirmation and substantive status remain fixed.

secondary_categories: Optional other mechanisms mentioned in the retained Note; some are tentative or symptoms of a diagnosed cause. See the full Note and flags. They overlap and are never summed as independent candidates; only the primary category enters totals.
